name: austincc.edu
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.
lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.
summary: www.austincc.edu scores 58 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: 20 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.

fix.title: 20 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /, /parents-families/, /recursos-para-padres-y-familias/, /business-community/ and 16 more. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (7 requests), Microsoft Clarity (5 requests), Snap Pixel (4 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Taboola (1 request), and cookies…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 2 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 11.1.14 (banner of /wp-content/plugins/slider-blocks/assets/js/swiper-bundle.min.js?ver=2.9.3): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-27212. Swiper versions >=6.5.1 and <12.1.2 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution that bypasses a…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 12.1.2 or later; upgrade DOMPurify to 3.4.16 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, for example #ub-icon-69ed6b50-c0ea-463e-848e-bccc8dc7cd21 > .ub_icon > .ub_icon_wrapper and .ub_icon_wrapper[rel="noopener"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 141 ms
Every page has a meta description
